source_query.raw_text: ILT layout with L-shaped branch, horizontal connector, branch fixed to top frame or free to slide, objective to minimize header and branch strains.

edpr_trace.summary: Existing EDPR example captures branch layout, connector, fixed/sliding options, and strain minimization objective.

retrieval_trace.summary: Expected retrieval should include GD-B, GD-BrPipe, GD-BOSS, GD-Con, EA-ST/EA-SB/EA-SH, connector stiffness, and pocket-region behavior.

solution_trace.summary: Solution should compare fixed and sliding branch support and explain header/branch strain trade-offs.

plot_trace.summary: Existing ILT plot example can be adapted for L-shaped branch visualization.

ratings.rationale: Branch component knowledge exists, but interaction between connector stiffness, fixed/sliding support, and branch strain should be tracked as a KEL future-study candidate when evidence is weak.

limitations: Feature interaction between branch restraint, connector stiffness, and strong-back frame may require FEA confirmation.
Free-to-slide support needs clear modelling assumptions before promotion into guidance.
